## 中文

- 修复官方线刷后 A/B 优先级相同时，“准备 OTA”被错误拒绝的问题。
- OTA 准备以 Android 当前实际运行槽为准；OTA 完成后的 boot 修补仍严格核对目标槽、镜像哈希和写入回读结果。
- 已在同一台实机连续完成 `0730 → 0813`、`0813 → 0828` 两次官方 OTA；两次均通过原版 boot 恢复、目标槽备份与修补、写入回读以及重启后 Root 验证。

## English

- Fixed OTA preparation being rejected when an official line flash leaves equal A/B priorities.
- Preparation now trusts the slot currently running Android. Post-OTA boot patching still verifies the scheduled target slot, image hashes, and write-back result.
- Verified two consecutive official OTA updates on the same device, `0730 → 0813` and `0813 → 0828`, including stock-boot restoration, target-slot backup and patching, write-back verification, and post-restart Root validation.
